argv: import ctypes,errno,platform; c=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True); n={'x86_64':110,'aarch64':173}[platform.machine()]; assert c.syscall(n)==-1 and ctypes.get_errno()==errno.EPERM; s=dict(x.split(':',1) for x in open('/proc/1/status') if ':' in x); assert s['Seccomp'].strip()=='2'
